exposure: Preservative cesarean delivery using uterine artery embolization due to morbidly adherent placenta
preservative cesarean delivery using uterine artery embolization due to morbidly adherent placenta
outcome: Ovarian reserve (measured by Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) levels)
cohort: 21 women who underwent preservative cesarean delivery with bilateral uterine artery embolization for morbidly adherent placenta, compared to 40 age-matched controls attending an infertility clinic
finding: Women who underwent preservative cesarean delivery using uterine artery embolization due to placenta accreta had lower ovarian reserve compared to age-matched controls.
